methodology.description: Public draft-helper PPR redraft board. Player value and market cost are intentionally kept separate. Rankings blend broad expert consensus, current projections, recent independent expert boards and material preseason/news context; ADP is treated as price rather than player quality. League scoring, roster construction, draft slot, drafted players, positional scarcity and next-pick pressure are applied by the client recommendation engine.
rankingInputs: FantasyPros 2026 PPR expert consensus (154 experts, Aug. 22)
FantasyPros independent PPR boards: Scott Bogman and Pat Fitzmaurice (Aug. 22), Derek Brown and Andrew Erickson (Aug. 21)
CBS Sports expert draft rankings, projections and preseason riser/faller analysis (Aug. 17-21)
NFL.com 2026 RB/WR draft tiers and current preseason reporting
ESPN 2026 offensive depth charts, projections and position profiles as a cross-check
methodology.marketInput: Current FantasyPros aggregated PPR ADP is the primary market-price input, including current ESPN, Sleeper, CBS, RTSports and Fantrax values where available. Sleeper-specific ADP is cross-checked separately. ADP is not used as a substitute for player value.
newsInputs: NFL.com and CBS Sports preseason Week 2 reporting reviewed through the completed Aug. 22 games; no new top-board injury, suspension, trade or usage event warranted a material value move in this refresh
NFL.com: Rashee Rice will not face additional league discipline after the NFL closed its investigation (Aug. 21); knee recovery remains the primary player-specific risk
CBS/Rotowire: Christian McCaffrey's preseason tightness remains described as minor, with San Francisco previously indicating he would practice if it were the regular season
CBS Sports: Jordyn Tyson's hamstring injury remains a meaningful early-season target-volume boost for Chris Olave
Seattle-Tennessee had not yet played its Aug. 23 preseason game at the time of this refresh, so no Sunday-night usage is incorporated
methodology.notes: Expert disagreement is preserved with expertLow/expertHigh ranges where current source coverage supports it. Confidence reflects agreement plus news certainty, not ceiling. The Aug. 23 refresh found no evidence strong enough to justify a material top-board rerank after the larger Aug. 22 update; value ranks are therefore intentionally stable while source freshness and disagreement inputs are refreshed. This file is used only by smhillis/sleeper-draft-helper-public and must not be copied into or used to modify Scott's personal Sleeper Draft Assistant.
